description: Codealong windows (the main one, one per project, the floating bar, its peek, the quick panel, the waiting window, the cards pinned to the desktop, the lines between them and the sessions kept there): board events, menus and dragging the toolbar, the bar, a card, a kept session or the waiting window by its strip. A window that isn't listed here can still run Codealong's commands, but its page is refused `listen`, so it never hears an event.
